WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(f.feerate) as avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(f.feerate) as overall_avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.orderbase,
    s1.avg_feerate,
    s1.avg_feerate - s2.overall_avg_feerate as diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg_feerate IS NOT NULL
    AND s1.avg_feerate > s2.overall_avg_feerate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(s3.avg_feerate) as avg_of_channel_avg_feerate,
  AVG(s3.diff) as avg_of_difference
FROM step3 s3
